01 / About

A little
about this.

✳

Curated projects by Y7XIFIED. Focused on crafting tactile web experiences, desktop environments, and exploring software architecture.

Special interest in operating systems, interactive retro recreations, and mechanical digital interfaces with tactile character. Bringing physical machine nostalgia into modern browser engineering.

Tracking operating system design, hardware ergonomics, and developer tooling while building practical tools and creative code experiments.

CORE INTERESTS Android, PC architecture, operating system customization, and open source.
